fuente.titulo: Civilians reach Ukraine after Oleshky evacuation backed by Pope and US First Lady

titular: Civilians evacuated from Oleshky reach Ukraine
bajada: Humanitarian ceasefire followed diplomacy by Pope Leo XIV and First Lady Melania Trump
caption: Hundreds of civilians have been evacuated from the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky under a rare humanitarian ceasefire. Some reached Ukrainian-controlled territory after a journey through Russia and Belarus, while others went to Russian-held areas. The operation followed diplomatic efforts involving Pope Leo XIV and U.S. First Lady Melania Trump. Source: Vatican News, Oct 31, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A quiet border crossing road at dusk with a line of civilian buses and figures carrying belongings, small Ukrainian flag visible in the upper right third, left and center of the frame left open and empty.
